/uploads: planned, not shipped: the pages say so (POST /uploads)
/lookup: the metadata service's route (audiosilo-meta), not the server's
pattern:/works/(?:match|\\{id\\})|/api/v: the metadata service's work lookup and match routes (audiosilo-meta), not the server's
/api/v1/works/{id}/recordings/{rid}/chap: the metadata service's route (audiosilo-meta), not the server's
/api/v1/intake/unknown-asins: the metadata service's intake route (audiosilo-meta), not the server's
/api/users: Audiobookshelf's API, which the listening import reads
/api/me: Audiobookshelf's API, which the listening import reads
/api/libraries: Audiobookshelf's API, which the listening import reads
/api/users/{id}: Audiobookshelf's API, which the listening import reads
podcasts.allow_networks: the Bridge's setting, named in the cross-repo contract
metadata.health: a field of GET /admin/system, not a config key
setup.can_contribute: a field of the Bridge heartbeat's setup block, not a config key
metadata.await: a label for the probe's block-file wait in the scanner page, not a config key
AUDIOSILO_ADMIN_NEXT: named as removed (the classic console's switch)
